subject: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@trustaudits.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Aegis Security Team <secops@aegisfinancial.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial

Hi Irene,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 intake for Aegis Financial and need to collect IAM/access artifacts to validate provisioning and SSO controls. Can you provide the following by Jul 29 (earlier if possible):

- SCIM delta feed (CSV) for the last 30 days showing Create/Update/Delete events, include attribute names and timestamps.
- A small sample (30–50 rows) of SAML assertion XMLs/text for successful logins and a handful of failed assertions (masked PII ok).
- Latest admin/service-account role matrix (who has which elevated roles).
- Mapping of role owners and an attestation that roles follow least-privilege (high level is OK).
- Any short notes on SCIM sync cadence and whether SCIM is one-way or bi-directional.

Preferred format: CSV for SCIM, plain text or zipped XML for assertions, and Excel for role matrix. If you can, include assertion timestamps in UTC and identify environment (prod/stage).

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute handoff call this week to walk exports.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ramos
Senior Auditor, TrustAudits
elena.ramos@trustaudits.io

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@trustaudits.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together an evidence package and can deliver an initial bundle ahead of Jul 29. Proposed plan: 

1) Initial package by EOD Thu Jul 24: SCIM delta (CSV) covering last 30 days, 30 SAML assertion samples (successful + 5 failed), and the current admin/service-account role matrix.
2) Full package with attestation and owner mapping by Mon Jul 28 (includes any additional logs you request).

Jonas will export the SCIM deltas and assertion excerpts. Karthik will help with the role-owner mapping and a short note on sync cadence.

Question: do you need separate files split by environment (prod/stage), or is a single file with an "environment" column acceptable? We can also mask user identifiers if you prefer.

We can do a 30-min call Thu Jul 24 at 09:00 PDT if that works.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@trustaudits.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial

I extracted the requested artifacts and attached an initial set. Notes below.

Attachments (initial):
- scim_delta_20250715_0722.csv (SCIM events, columns: event_type, timestamp_utc, user_id, email, external_id, attribute_changed)
- saml_assertions_excerpt_20250722.txt (30 assertion excerpts; all PII redacted in this file)
- admin_role_matrix_v2.xlsx (current elevated roles and group membership)

Quick notes:
- SCIM sync is one-way (IdP -> Redwood), cadence is near-real-time with batch reconciliations nightly.
- Assertions include env tag in the sample. I redacted full emails and external IDs; we can provide masked or unmapped versions depending on your needs.
- For failed assertions, the file includes a short failure_reason field.

I uploaded the raw exports to the compliance drive (internal link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1-example-internal-scim-exports

If you want the user_id column masked differently (hash vs truncated), tell me and I'll regenerate.

—Jonas

From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@trustaudits.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial

Thanks Jonas & Irene — I see the initial upload. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Please split the SCIM CSV by environment (prod vs stage) or add an explicit environment column. That will speed our sampling.
- For the SAML assertions, include at least 3 failed assertion examples (masked) with timestamps in UTC.
- We need one SCIM file with user identifiers masked (pseudonymous) for sharing with the external review panel. The masking approach should be consistent (either deterministic hash or truncated id).

If you could re-send the masked SCIM CSV and a masked assertions file by EOD Wed Jul 23 that would be ideal. I added the HubSpot intake for this engagement: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/AG-998

Thanks — Elena

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@trustaudits.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SOC 2 intake - Aegis Financial

Elena — thanks, we'll deliver the masked files and schedule the handoff call. Updated deliverables and attachments: 

- scim_delta_20250715_0722_masked.csv (environment column included; user_id pseudonymized via SHA256 prefix)
- saml_assertions_excerpt_20250722_masked.txt (includes 3 failed assertions; timestamps in UTC)
- admin_role_matrix_v2.xlsx (unchanged)

Call scheduled: Thu Jul 24, 2025 at 09:00 PDT (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent separately.

If you need additional fields in the SCIM CSV (e.g., last_login), let us know before the call and we'll try to include them.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
